old_findings.note: The mulDiv expansions are unchanged (239 mulmod lines). getTwapFromOracle's return now prints prod1/prod0 >> 64 as Bytes(8, uint64(...)), Bytes(24, ...) instead of an OR; this is exact, and the operand is still repeated about 15 times.

0 calls left with the selector as a memory slice (old 44 lines) and 0 unnamed calls (old 8). slot0, observations, positions, decreaseLiquidity, collect, increaseLiquidity, mint, approve, feeAmountTickSpacing and increaseObservationCardinalityNext are all named with their arguments.
There are still 15 'calldata.size - 4 >=′ 0' checks, 94 two-armed min(32, return_data.size) assignments, and 6 whole-slot stor[0] reads.

regressions.source: LiquidityManagerCore: emit PositionFeesCollected/Decreased/Increased(pool, positionId, ..., tokens, amounts); return (positionId, liquidity, amounts)
regressions.issue: A variable holding mem[64] and mem[64] itself are now both used for the same value with no store in between, and x - mem[64] is never folded to 0. A length also keeps the copy loop's final pointer u. As a result, 3 events and 2 returns lost their decoded words (the uint128 liquidity, the head offsets) and became raw memory slices.
regressions.rule: After x = mem[64] with no store to mem[64] in between, x and mem[64] are one value: print one name and fold x - mem[64] to 0. Close loop exit values (u = base + 32 * count), so that log and return ranges split into the words just stored.
regressions.verified: reading only; text_check run --per-selector 16: 0 different (483 calls)

regressions.source: via-IR allocations and abi.encode of the custom error and of the arrays (new uint256[](n), revert Error(tokens, amounts))
regressions.issue: Every use of the free pointer is replaced by its full symbolic value, a sum of 8 to 10 terms, so the allocation checks and stores grow to 300-1000 characters. Lines over 240 characters went from 315 to 383 and the text has 4% more characters despite 10% fewer lines.
regressions.rule: Substitute the free pointer's value only when it is short (a constant or base + constant). Otherwise keep it as mem[64], or bind it once to a variable where it is read, and address memory relative to that name.

new_findings.decompiled: log 0x61af548e...: 64, Bytes(16, 0), ext_call.return_data[16 len 16], 2, ext_call.return_data[32 len 64], indexed _v
new_findings.source: emit PositionLiquidityIncreased-like event (uint256[] amounts, uint128 liquidity)
new_findings.issue: The words are now decoded, but the uint128 is spelled as a byte concatenation and the array as a raw offset and length. The same event in increaseLiquidity prints as Array(len=2, data=ext_call.return_data[32 len 64]), uint128(ext_call.return_data[0]).
new_findings.rule: A word that is Bytes(16, 0) followed by the low 16 bytes of w is uint128(w); a head offset that points at a (len, data) tail prints as one Array argument.

improvements: Every call is now named with decoded arguments (44 selector-as-memory lines and 8 unnamed calls are gone). Custom errors carry values: 0x9eb241a7 shows its int24 instead of mem[4], and the two-array 0x6810c7f8 is decoded. 'revert with memory' became 'revert with ext_call.return_data[...]'. Dominated Panic(50) bounds checks on known lengths were folded (46 -> 4 in decreaseLiquidity). Returns of changeRanges, convertToV3 and checkPoolAndGetCenterPrice are values, and P2 20 -> 0, P6 8 -> 0.
notes: Reviewed by structure (6290-line diff): for all 7 changed functions, call/log/return/require/revert counts and lines were compared, and every changed while was classified. All whiles are implicit ABI copies, as in round 1 (57 -> 49); no source loop exists. Calls, logs and requires are equal in number in every function. The removed reverts are dominated Panic(50) checks and 'revert with memory' lines now shown as return-data reverts. The three small functions were read diff by diff. The new pack has no pattern line; P1-P6 come from regexes that reproduce round 1's counts. FeesCollected's data prints as mem[... len ceil32(min(64, return_data.size))], ext_call.return_data[0 len 64]: exact on reachable paths but opaque (old: fully raw).
summary: Two medium readability regressions, both from the free-pointer change: 3 events and 2 returns at function ends fell back to raw memory with unfolded x - mem[64], and via-IR allocation code substitutes long symbolic pointer sums. Otherwise the text improved a lot: all calls are named, custom errors are decoded, and dominated bounds checks are folded.
